race.comment: Good race. At the prices, we'll bite the bullet on the likely speed map and back in the talent of MR NATURAL (14) who got a mile back first up here on an on-pace dominated day but absolutely flew home from a hopeless spot to win his maiden. How far back he gets will be the query again but he looks very progressive. BRASS IN POCKET (12) resumes. She looked good in four runs to date and draws well, watch the betting. CASTELLITO (11) struggled at Pakenham Synthetic last time but can bounce back on turf, the effort in town two back is solid form for this. OLE ROYALE (3) resumed with a smart win at Ballarat and has been kept fresh, he'll take holding out again.
